review:
An eco-future scrapyard cluster game made with Bullshark Games, with a robot sidekick that reacts to what's happening. Tesla Coil symbols spark multipliers that keep climbing.

Wilds carry random values that boost clusters, and cell multipliers rise with every payout, so momentum really matters. High volatility, 10,000x max and 96.14% RTP. Free spins about once every 276 spins. A good pick if you like cell-multiplier cluster games.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
